scope: Research calibration only. This dossier neither approves a date audit nor changes a source, extraction, date claim, hint, or chronology registry.

sampleUnits.quote: 開元初，授汝州刺史，為政嚴簡，州境肅然。
開元二十一年正月，制曰："繼好之義，雖屬邊鄙；
齊物天寶初開砥柱之險，以通流運，於石中得古鐵犁鏵，有「平陸」字，因改河北縣為平陸縣，加齊物銀青光祿大夫，為鴻臚卿、河南尹。
貞元十年，鄭滑節度使李融卒，軍中潰亂，以復檢校兵部尚書，兼滑州刺史、義成軍節度、鄭滑觀察營田等使、兼御史大夫。

reignsRegistry.finding: The production reign registry has no Tang entries. Its schema forbids provenance fields on individual reign rows, so it cannot by itself serve as an independently pinned historical citation.

chronologyReference.scope: Reviewed pilot seed, not a complete corpus chronology
chronologyReference.finding: This is the permitted pinning mechanism: every source requires an HTTPS URL, title, checked date, and optional immutable local quotation; every reign-year entry names its source and has one exact Western year. The loader rejects missing, stale, or mismatched citations.

enforcement.finding: lookupChronology explicitly returns a blocker when no reviewed mapping exists and says not to convert from memory. chronologyCitationErrors rejects a Western date when the cited registry row does not match it.

externalCalibrationSource.title: Chinese historical chronology: Tang dynasty calendar table
externalCalibrationSource.quote:
开元：713年十二月—741年
天宝：742年—756年七月
贞元：785年—805年八月
externalCalibrationSource.interpretation: The table supplies conventional Western-year labels for each named Tang era. It supports a linear mapping within these uninterrupted ranges, but not Gregorian month/day conversion and not personal activity dates merely because a person is mentioned nearby.

decision.conclusion: A permitted, integrity-checked pinning method exists, and this calibration supplies a source suitable for a separately reviewed Tang registry addition. The current registry has no Tang mapping, so no Jiu Tangshu 116 conversion is approved or safe to apply now.
decision.requiredNextStep: A separate curator may propose the source and only the needed exact reign-year rows in chronology-reference.json, validate the registry, and obtain independent review before using a row on any claim. The local chapter evidence must still establish that the dated event belongs to the named person.
decision.prohibitedInference: Do not use the era table to turn an undated title, genealogy, reception mention, or another person’s event into this person’s activity, birth, or death date.
